_about: Tiffany's 'Questionable for FYM' review list (CLAUDE.md rule 6: when in doubt, PULL IT). Every item here stays hidden in FYM (gate [3d]) until Tiffany says keep (then drop it from this list and un-hide; update locks.json in the same commit). Fields: key (FYM mat id), img (FYM photo), name, brand, reason, photo (repo path or FYM path to look at), candidate (alternate photo, if any).
